audit.title: Recent audit trail for the post/case (up to 20 actions)
audit.empty: No actions have been recorded for this case yet.

unknown.label: Unrecognized action
unknown.description: This action is in the history, but this version of the panel cannot describe it.

report_status_changed.label: Report status updated
report_status_changed.description: A moderation team member changed the status of a report (earlier report workflow).

post_hidden.label: Post hidden
post_hidden.description: A moderation team member hid the post (earlier report workflow).

post_restored.label: Post restored
post_restored.description: A moderation team member made the post visible again.

post_quarantined.label: Hidden as a precaution
post_quarantined.description: The system hid the post automatically when the report threshold was reached, pending human review.

case_rejected.label: Decision: Not valid
case_rejected.description: A moderation team member closed the cycle without removing the post; if it was hidden as a precaution, it is published again.

content_actioned.label: Decision: Valid
content_actioned.description: A moderation team member ruled the reports valid: the post is removed from public view and permanently deleted after 72 hours.

strike_applied.label: Strike applied
strike_applied.description: Someone with a moderator, developer or admin role applied a sanction to the author for this decision.

strike_revoked.label: Strike revoked
strike_revoked.description: Someone with a developer or admin role revoked the author's sanction; the post is not restored.

post_purged.label: Post permanently deleted
post_purged.description: The system permanently deleted the post and its content when the retention period ended.

strikeUnavailable.title: Author sanction
strikeUnavailable.message: The sanction status could not be loaded. This does not mean there is no sanction: try again before deciding.

queue.hiddenOnly: Only posts hidden as a precaution
queue.author: Author (username)
queue.authorHint: Type at least 2 characters (letters, numbers or _).
queue.rangeInvalid: The start date cannot be after the end date.
queue.updateFailed: The queue could not be refreshed. Previous results are shown.
queue.invalidPage: This page is no longer valid. Go back to the start of the queue.

pending.label: Pending cases
pending.count: {count, plural, one {# pending case} other {# pending cases}}
pending.error: Pending cases could not be counted.

media.imageError: This image could not be loaded.
media.videoError: This video could not be loaded.
media.retryHint: If it keeps failing, refresh the case: file access may have expired.

report.title: Report post
report.intro: Tell us what is wrong with this post. The moderation team will review it; your identity is not shown to other users.
report.copyrightNote: If you are the copyright holder of what was posted, this report is not the right channel: use the copyright claim form.
report.detailHelp: Do not include personal data about yourself or others.
report.successBody: Thank you. The moderation team will review it.
report.successAlready: You had already reported this post. Your report is still under review.

errors.detailInvalid: The explanation contains characters that are not allowed.
errors.selfReport: You cannot report your own post.
errors.notReportable: This post can no longer be reported.
errors.generic: We could not send the report. Please try again in a few minutes.

form.title: Copyright claim
form.intro: If you are a rights holder, or act on behalf of one, and you believe a community post infringes your work, tell us here. You do not need an account.
form.manualReview: A member of the moderation team reviews every claim. Sending one does not automatically hide or remove any post.

fields.infringementDescription: What in the post infringes it
fields.evidenceUrls: Links that show you hold the rights

hints.workDescription: Title, author, year and where it was first published.
hints.infringementDescription: Explain which content in the post is yours or copies your work.
hints.evidenceUrls: One link per line (up to 5, http or https only). File attachments are not accepted.
hints.postUrl: Paste the post address (for example, the one ending in /community/…).
hints.signature: Typing your name counts as signing this claim.

relationship.authorized_representative: I represent the rights holder with their authorisation

statements.rightsHolder: I am the rights holder of the work described, or I am authorised to act on their behalf.
statements.goodFaith: I believe in good faith that the use described is not authorised by the rights holder, their agent or the law.
statements.accurate: The information in this claim is accurate to the best of my knowledge.

errors.evidenceUrlsInvalid: Check the links: one per line, starting with http:// or https://, with no spaces.
errors.evidenceUrlsTooMany: You can include at most 5 links.
errors.statementsRequired: You must confirm the statements to send the claim.

received.title: Claim received
received.body: Thank you. The moderation team will review it and, if more information is needed, will write to the email you gave.
received.referenceHint: Keep this reference in case you need to mention it.

failures.rateLimited: You have sent too many claims. Try again in {minutes} min.
failures.invalid: We could not validate the form. Check the details and try again.
failures.unavailable: We could not send the claim. Try again in a few minutes; your details are still in the form.

panel.title: Copyright claims
panel.safeNote: Reviewing a claim only changes its status. A post is hidden only through the explicit “Remove the post” action, which requires a second confirmation.

empty.closed: There are no closed claims yet.

detail.title: Claim details
detail.loadError: The claim could not be loaded.

fields.snapshot: Post text when the claim was received
fields.snapshotEmpty: No text, or post not found

events.notification_failed: Failed to send the notice to the author
events.strike_notified: Strike notice sent to the author
events.strike_notification_failed: Strike notice to the author failed

actions.title: Review
actions.noteHelp: Required to request information, dismiss, record a withdrawal or add a note. Up to 1000 characters.
actions.closed: This claim is closed and can no longer be changed.

errors.note_required: Write a note for this action.
errors.invalid_note: The note is not valid (1 to 1000 characters, no control characters).
errors.version_conflict: The claim changed while you were reviewing it. We reloaded the data; check it and try again.
errors.invalid_transition: That action is no longer possible in the current status.
errors.generic: The review could not be recorded. Try again.

remove.intro: Removing HIDES the post immediately without deleting its files, and emails the author (in English) the reference, the reason and a personal appeal link. Before removing, manually check the claimant's legitimacy and evidence.
remove.noPost: It cannot be removed: the post could not be found.
remove.notPublished: It cannot be removed: the post is not published (current status: {status}).
remove.reasonLabel: Reason for the removal (the author receives it)
remove.reasonHelp: 10 to 1000 characters. It is copied as written into the email to the author: write it in English and without the claimant's personal data.
remove.done: Post removed. The author was notified by email.

confirm.removeWarning: The post will be hidden right now. Nothing is deleted. An email in English will be sent to the author with the reference, the reason and a personal appeal link.
confirm.purgeWarning: The post will be deleted and its exclusive files will be marked for deletion. This cannot be undone.

info.deadlinePending: Starts once the initial notice is confirmed as sent.

noticeErrors.no_recipient: the author's account has no email

notice.failedNow: The decision was saved, but the notice to the author could not be sent ({error}). It remains pending a resend.
notice.initialPending: The initial notice to the author has not been sent yet: the appeal window has not started and permanent deletion is blocked.
notice.resendInitial: Retry the notice to the author
notice.resolutionPending: The resolution notice to the author is pending.

appeal.title: Author's appeal

reasons.authorized: I have permission or a licence
reasons.legal_exception: Use covered by a legal exception
reasons.mistake: The content was identified by mistake

appeal.noteLabel: Justification for the decision (required; included in the email to the author)
appeal.noteHelp: 1 to 1000 characters. Accepting restores the post if it is still as the removal left it; rejecting keeps it hidden.
appeal.acceptedDone: Appeal accepted: the post was restored and the case moves to the history.
appeal.rejectedDone: Appeal rejected: the post stays hidden.

purge.title: Permanent deletion (manual)
purge.intro: Nothing is deleted when the window ends. Only a moderator can do this once every condition is met; the server checks them again.

blockers.appeal_pending: An appeal is waiting for a decision.
blockers.not_removed: The post is not in a removed state.
blockers.notification_pending: The initial notice to the author has not been sent successfully yet.
blockers.window_open: The appeal window is still open.
blockers.resolution_notice_pending: The resolution notice to the author is pending.

purge.done: Post deleted. {marked} files were marked for deletion; {retained} were kept because they are shared or belong elsewhere.
purge.assetsPending: {count} files are waiting for the storage cleanup process.
purge.assetsDone: All marked files have been deleted.

errors.note_required: Write the justification or note this action requires.
errors.invalid_reason: The reason must be 10 to 1000 characters long and cannot contain control characters.
errors.invalid_note: The text is not valid (1 to 1000 characters, no control characters).
errors.version_conflict: The case changed while you were reviewing it. We reloaded the data; check it and try again.
errors.invalid_transition: That action is no longer possible in the current status.
errors.confirmation_mismatch: The confirmation does not match the claim.
errors.post_state_conflict: The post is no longer in the expected state.
errors.post_version_conflict: The post changed since you saw it. We reloaded the data; check it and try again.
errors.restore_unsafe: It cannot be restored safely: the post changed since the removal. The appeal remains pending.
errors.purge_blocked: The conditions for permanent deletion are not met yet.
errors.generic: The action could not be completed. Try again.

strike.title: Copyright strike
strike.intro: A strike is a human decision, independent from the deletion: it can only be applied once the post has been permanently deleted. It counts together with Community strikes when the level is decided.
strike.loadError: The strike status could not be loaded.

confirm.title: Confirm the strike
confirm.reasonLabel: Reason for the strike (the author receives it)
confirm.reasonHelp: Required, up to 1000 characters. It is copied as written into the email to the author: write it in English and without personal data of the claimant.
confirm.reasonError: Write a reason (1000 characters at most).
confirm.irreversible: The author will receive an email in English with the level, the duration and this reason. There is no new appeal: only an administrator can correct it with the existing controls.

effect.1: Blocks new Community posts and edits for 14 days.
effect.2: Blocks new Community posts and edits for 1 month.
effect.3: Permanently blocks new Community posts and edits.

blockers.claim_not_purged: A strike can only be applied once the post has been permanently deleted.
blockers.author_unavailable: A strike cannot be applied: the author account is no longer available.
blockers.self_strike_forbidden: You cannot apply a strike to your own content.
blockers.strike_already_issued: This claim already has a strike.

strike.doneNoticeFailed: Strike applied, but the email notice failed: you can resend it.

errors.level_changed: The level changed while you were confirming. Review the new level and confirm again.
errors.strike_already_issued: This claim already has a strike.
errors.claim_not_purged: A strike can only be applied after the permanent deletion.
errors.author_unavailable: The author account is no longer available.
errors.self_strike_forbidden: You cannot apply a strike to your own content.
errors.generic: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

appeal.title: Appeal a copyright removal
appeal.intro: If you think we removed one of your posts by mistake, you can appeal here. A moderator decides every appeal; submitting it does not restore anything by itself.

incomplete.title: Incomplete link
incomplete.body: Open the personal link from the email you received again to appeal. If you switched devices, open that link there.

signIn.title: Sign in with the author account
signIn.body: To appeal you must sign in with the same account that published the removed post. You will come back to this page afterwards.

notAvailable.title: Appeal not available
notAvailable.body: This link is not valid for your account, or the appeal is no longer available. Check that you are signed in with the author account and that you opened the latest link in the email.

submitted.title: Appeal submitted
submitted.body: You already submitted an appeal for this removal. We will email you when it is decided.

expired.title: The appeal window has ended
expired.body: Appeals are no longer accepted for this removal. The post stays hidden; a moderator will decide the next steps.

closed.title: This case is closed
closed.body: This removal can no longer be appealed.

appeal.noUploads: We only ask for text and links. Do not upload identity documents or files: this form does not accept them.

fields.explanation: Explain why the removal is a mistake

hints.evidence: Give evidence as text, as links or both (at least one).
hints.evidenceUrls: One link per line (maximum 5, http or https only).

reasons.authorized: I have permission or a licence
reasons.legal_exception: Use covered by a legal exception
reasons.mistake: The content was identified by mistake

appeal.statement: I declare that the information in this appeal is true and accurate to the best of my knowledge.

errors.evidenceRequired: Provide evidence as text or links.
errors.evidenceUrlsInvalid: Check the links: one per line, starting with http:// or https://, with no spaces.
errors.evidenceUrlsTooMany: You can include at most 5 links.
errors.statementRequired: You must confirm the statement to submit the appeal.

submitted.title: Appeal submitted
submitted.body: Thank you. The moderation team will review it and email you the decision. The post is not deleted while the appeal is pending.

failures.invalid: We could not validate the form. Check your details and try again.
failures.error: We could not complete the operation. Try again in a few minutes.
failures.alreadySubmitted: An appeal was already submitted for this removal.
failures.windowClosed: The appeal window has already ended.
failures.notAvailable: This appeal is no longer available.
failures.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in again and open the link in the email once more.

caseDetail.title: Report details
caseDetail.closureAuthorDeleted: Administrative closure: the author's account was deleted. This is not a moderation decision: it does not mean the reports were upheld or dismissed, and it creates no strike.

page.title: Moderation
page.accessError: Couldn't check your access. Please try again.
page.accessLost: Your moderation access is no longer available.
page.noAccess: You don't have access to the moderation panel.
page.mfaUnconfirmed: We couldn't confirm your recent two-step verification.
page.caseGone: The case is no longer available in this queue. Check the updated information.
page.caseIds: Case {caseId} · Cycle {cycle} · Current case version {version} · Post {postId}
page.contentExpired: This post's content has expired and is no longer available. No snapshot of its text or media is kept.
page.currentContent: The current content is shown, not a historical snapshot of the report.
page.updatedAfter: The post was updated after the first report.
page.purgedOn: The post was permanently deleted on {date}. No snapshot of its text or media is kept.
page.originalGone: The original post is no longer available. No snapshot of its text or media is kept.
page.legacyClosure: Historical closure; no grouped decision recorded
page.decisionClosure: Cycle closed by a recorded decision
page.previousCycle: This is an earlier cycle. The post shown reflects its current state.
page.closedReportsNote: Reports from closed cycles don't add votes to the current cycle. A historical count of accounts isn't reconstructed.
page.reporters: {qualifying} qualifying accounts · {total} reports in the cycle
page.hiddenNote: Hidden as a precaution because of the report threshold. Human review is pending: this doesn't confirm a violation or apply a strike.
page.strikeChanged: This case's moderation state changed. We updated the information so you can review it again.
page.caseChanged: This case changed while you were reviewing it. We updated the information so you can review it again.
page.truncated: Showing the 50 most recent reports out of {total}. There are more reports in this cycle.
page.pendingDecision: This case is pending a moderation decision.
page.noActive: There are no active cases for now.
page.noClosed: There are no closed cycles for now.

effect.1: Blocks new Community posts and edits for 14 days.
effect.2: Blocks new Community posts and edits for 1 month.
effect.3: Permanently blocks new Community posts and edits.

ineligible.author_unavailable: A strike can't be applied: the author's account is no longer available.
ineligible.self_strike_forbidden: You can't apply a strike to your own content.

strike.ineligibleGeneric: A strike can't be applied in this case.
strike.resumed: Review the context and confirm again. The action has not been repeated.
strike.revokeOwn: You can't revoke this strike because you applied it: another person with a developer or administrator role must revoke it.
strike.revokeRole: Only developers or administrators can revoke a strike.
strike.separate: The author will still be able to delete their own posts. Upheld and strike are separate actions: this case has already been decided.
strike.applyIntro: The reason you write will be seen by the author. The level and duration are decided by the server on confirmation.
strike.applyLabel: Reason for the strike (visible to the author)
strike.revokeIntro1: Revoking removes this strike from the calculation of future strikes.
strike.revokeIntro2: It doesn't automatically restore a removed post or reverse the moderation decision.

errors.noAccess: Your access for this action is no longer available.
errors.uncertain: We couldn't confirm the result. Close this dialog to refresh the case before acting again.
errors.generic: The action couldn't be completed. Check your connection and refresh the case before trying again.

decision.deletedNote: The post no longer exists (it was deleted), so there is no content to remove: this case can only be closed as “Not upheld”.
decision.bodyValid: The case will be closed and the post will be removed. Its content will be kept for 72 hours. This decision doesn't apply a strike.
decision.bodyNotValid: The case will be closed and its pending reports will be dismissed. If the post is hidden as a precaution because of this case, it will be restored according to the moderation rules.
decision.resumed: Review the context and confirm again. The decision has not been repeated.

errors.messageRequired: Write a resolution message of up to 1000 characters.
errors.prepare: The decision couldn't be prepared. Refresh the context.
errors.noAccess: Your moderation access is no longer available.
errors.uncertain: We couldn't confirm the result. Close this dialog and refresh the context before acting again.
errors.reviewMessage: Check the message and refresh the context before confirming.
errors.generic: The decision couldn't be completed. Check your connection and refresh the context before trying again.

done.notValid: The case was closed as Not upheld.
done.valid: The post was removed and the case was closed.
